$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: 3MF export
blocks.for: The multi-colour 3MF file a slicer opens: parts, filament colours, project presets and the provenance mark, centred on the plate the customer picked. exportPartOf makes a part from a manifold mesh.

blocks.name: STL export
blocks.for: One binary STL of the whole model, all parts merged.

blocks.name: OBJ export
blocks.for: Wavefront OBJ, plain or with an MTL of colours.

blocks.name: Laser cut file
blocks.for: The laser SVG: one group per operation (engrave, score, cut), one unit per millimetre, the provenance mark inside.

blocks.name: Provenance mark
blocks.for: Invariant #2: the forensic mark every exported file carries, never visible on a print. With sourceModel it credits an uploaded model to its creator.

blocks.name: Download and zip
blocks.for: Save bytes, text or a ready Blob to the downloads folder, and bundle several files into one zip.
